verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is API-first: a REST API plus five official SDKs, and stateless header auth (x-api-key + x-organization-id, with no OAuth flow or session to keep alive). Keys can be set to never expire, and several can be held at once so rotation causes no downtime. Together this makes unattended, headless automation straightforward, and the idempotent tax estimate endpoint is safe for repeated test calls. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g. GitHub Actions examples or a sandbox/test environment), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
